title: Facade Profile Inspector
description: Architectural software is rendering a 3D building model represented as a binary tree of rooms. Imagine you are standing directly to the right side of the building, looking inward. Return the list of room identifiers that are visible from the rightmost perspective, ordered from the top floor down to the ground floor.
constraints: The number of nodes in the tree is in the range [0, 100].
output_format: A list of integers representing the rightmost visible nodes at each level.

examples.explanation: Looking from the right, nodes 1, 3, and 4 are visible.
Only node 1 and the right child 3 are present.
An empty structure yields no viewable elements.
